review_candidates.title: SAP Engineer
review_candidates.location: Ho Chi Minh City Metropolitan Area
review_candidates.description: Company Description 4P’s, headquartered in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, operates 40 worldwide restaurants. Our main restaurant, Pizza 4P’s, has 35 stores in Vietnam and manages global franchises like IPPUDO and ABOUT LIFE COFFEE BREWERS. Our core products are food and beverages, specifically pizza, with key differentiators of "House-made cheeses", "Earth-to-people" and "Omotenashi" hospitality. Pizza 4P’s is an innovative Vietnam-based Japanese Italian pizza restaurant that started in Vietnam with a simple yet powerful mission: “Delivering Wow, Sharing Happiness”. We are known for crafting artisanal pizzas, homemade cheese, and unique East-meets-West flavors while embracing sustainability and community impact at the heart of everything we do. Today, we operate restaurants across Vietnam, Cambodia, Japan, India and Indonesia, and continue to grow with a vision of bringing people together through memorable dining experiences. I. ROLE PURPOSE We are looking for an SAP Solution Engineer to take technical ownership of our SAP landscape. Today that means our SAP Business One installation: keeping it running, resolving user issues, and delivering new configuration and enhancements as the business grows. Over time it means preparing the ground for a future move to SAP S/4HANA. This is a hands-on ownership role. You will be the person who knows how the system is actually configured, why it behaves the way it does, and what it will take to change it. You are expected to understand the business processes behind the system well enough to challenge a requirement before it gets built, not only to implement what you are handed. Reports to: Head of Engineering Works with: Finance, Supply Chain, Production, Retail Operations, Data & BI II. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES System ownership and support - Take over full working knowledge of the current SAP Business One installation — configuration, customisations, integrations, and any undocumented behaviour — and document it. - Provide day-to-day support to SAP users across Finance, Supply Chain, Production and Retail: investigate, resolve, and root-cause issues within agreed response times. - Distinguish user error, data error, configuration gap and genuine defect — and fix the underlying cause. - Manage escalations to our SAP partner or vendor, and hold them accountable for resolution quality. Implementation and enhancement - Translate business requirements into working configuration: user-defined fields and tables, formatted searches, approval procedures, document settings, authorisations. - Build and maintain integrations between SAP and our operational systems (POS, e-commerce, internal platforms) using the Service Layer, DI API, or middleware. - Write and review technical specifications; brief and supervise external developers where custom development is needed. - Own unit testing and SIT, support business users through UAT, and manage release and change control. - Push back on customisation that standard functionality already covers, and keep a record of every customisation and why it exists. Master data - Own SAP master data as a system: item/material, business partner, pricing, BOM/recipe, chart of accounts, cost centres. - Define and enforce master data standards — naming, mandatory fields, ownership, approval flow. - Build tooling for bulk creation, mass change, and validation; run regular data quality checks and drive remediation with business owners. Reporting - Build and maintain operational and financial reports (Crystal Reports, SAP B1 queries, dashboards). - Work with the Data & BI team on extraction into the central analytics platform; agree what belongs in SAP and what belongs downstream. - Rationalise the existing report estate — retire what is unused, standardise what is duplicated. S/4HANA readiness (ongoing, not a project) - Maintain a current inventory of processes, customisations, integrations and master data objects so a future migration starts from facts, not archaeology. - Keep master data clean and structured in a way that will survive a migration. - Flag any proposed customisation that would be difficult to carry forward. - Build your own S/4HANA capability through training and certification, supported by the company. III. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS Education Bachelor‘s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Information Systems, Accounting/Finance, or a related field. Experience - 1–3 years hands-on experience implementing and supporting an ERP system (SAP, or a comparable enterprise ERP). - Experience through at least one **full implementation or major rollout** — not support tickets alone. You have seen requirements, build, testing, cutover and the aftermath. - Working understanding of core business processes end to end: **procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, record-to-report, inventory and production**. Deep enough to spot when a specification will not work before it gets built. - **Strong SQL.** You can query, join, reconcile and investigate data independently. This is non-negotiable. - Experience building reports for business users. - Experience with system integration — APIs, file interfaces, or middleware. - Structured and self-directed: able to take an undocumented system and make sense of it without being walked through it. - Certification (mandatory): A current SAP Certified Associate qualification in S/4HANA Language - English — professional working proficiency. - Vietnamese — professional working proficiency. IV. NICE TO HAVE - Exposure to **SAP S/4HANA or ECC** — configuration, CDS views, Fiori, or migration work. - Experience in **F&B, retail, or manufacturing**: recipe/BOM management, production orders, multi-outlet inventory. - ABAP debugging (reading and tracing, not writing). - SAP certification. - ClickUp, Jira, or similar delivery tooling. - Experience working alongside an external implementation partner.

review_candidates.title: Production Welding Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Description To provide qualified welding engineering support for ongoing and upcoming projects by ensuring safe, efficient, and high-quality welding operations from prefabrication through final assembly, while meeting approved procedures, project specifications, productivity targets, and delivery schedules. The Production Welding Engineer will coordinate and improve welding activities to ensure safe, efficient, and compliant production while achieving project targets, minimizing weld repairs, and ensuring timely welding resources and technical support. Responsibilities Review project specifications, drawings, codes, standards, WPSs, and NDT requirements to ensure welding compliance. Coordinate welding documentation, including WPSs, welder qualifications, registers, and production test coupons. Plan welding work fronts, station layouts, manpower, equipment, consumables, production targets, and logistics. Monitor welding production and quality, ensuring proper fit-up, preheating, consumable control, and compliance with approved procedures. Coordinate with Quality, Maintenance, Warehouse, Construction, Scaffolding, and Project Management teams to maintain efficient workflow. Track welding progress, productivity, NDT results, repair rates, equipment, and consumable requirements. Investigate welding defects, delays, and nonconformities; implement corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives. Support achievement of production, quality, safety, schedule, and cost objectives while minimizing rework and weld repairs. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Welding Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Fresh graduates are welcome to apply. Candidates with 1–3 years of experience in welding production or a similar industrial environment will be an advantage. ⁠Basic understanding of welding processes, WPS/PQR, welder qualifications and NDT. Basic knowledge of applicable welding codes and standards, such as AWS D1.1 ASME IX and ISO 1906. Professional welding certification such as CSWIP 3.0. 3.1, IWE/IWT, NDT or equivalent qualification is an advantage. Good communication, coordination, problem-solving, teamwork, and time-management skills. Proactive, willing to learn, and able to work in a fast-paced fabrication/production environment. Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Word, with the ability to prepare basic production reports and monitor welding-related data and KPIs.
